question: Which government body is most likely involved in organising or supporting Esports Conclave 2025?

options.text: Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports

solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Esports Conclave 2025** is a significant gathering aimed at fostering the growth of the competitive gaming ecosystem in **India**, involving key stakeholders like developers, athletes, and policymakers.
 
• The **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports** is the most likely body involved because **Esports** was officially recognized as a "multisport event" by the **Government of India** in **December 2022**. ***Hence, the statement is correct.***
 
• Following an amendment to the **Allocation of Business Rules, 1961**, the President of India directed that **Esports** be included under the **Department of Sports** within this Ministry.
